authority.known_outcome_warning: The five conditions and their cut points were chosen after inspecting errors across these historical periods. No period in this run is sealed or out of sample for the tail-risk hypothesis.
authority.allowed_conclusion: A recipe may be retained only as a shadow risk marker. It cannot authorize a trade, replace a displayed candidate, or promote a production model.
authority.prospective_requirement: Lock one marker before collecting at least 100 new source-complete sessions; evaluate it once without threshold changes.

unrestricted_e0.empirical_diagnosis: E0 changed the ranking instead of enforcing monotone avoidance. Its displayed candidates carried materially more registered tail flags than G0, so free coefficients did not encode the cash-veto mechanism.
unrestricted_e0.causal_limit: The comparison is retrospective and does not identify which coefficient caused the turnover or prove that the flags cause losses.

decision.conclusion: No recipe may be promoted. A passing recipe would only become a prospective shadow marker because its thresholds were selected after these outcomes were known.

limitations: All five thresholds are post-hoc and every evaluated outcome was known.
Cash veto results measure avoided historical P&L, not causal effects.
No rank-three replacement or portfolio reallocation was tested.
Exact 08:58 futures, board imbalance, PTS and indicative-open fields are absent.
